message.content: Hey, I need you to draft a quick message to my regular client, Mrs. van der Merwe. I forgot to confirm the final proof delivery time for her wedding album. It’s for next Friday, the 17th. Can you make it sound professional but warm?

content.text: Sure, Thandiwe. Here is a draft: "Dear Mrs. van der Merwe, I hope you are settling in well after the wedding. I am writing to confirm that your final wedding album proofs will be delivered for your review on Friday, 17 April. Please let me know if this time works for you. Warm regards, Thandiwe Dlamini." Does this work for you?

message.content: That looks good. Send it. Now, what’s on my plate for today? I’m trying to figure out what to cook for dinner because I’m exhausted from editing.

content.text: You have a grocery delivery scheduled for later today. Do you want to keep it with Checkers Sixty60, or are you still thinking about switching to Pick n Pay PnP Now? You mentioned that on Wednesday 8 April.

message.content: Right, I did say that. I’m still not decided. The PnP app has better prices on dairy, but I hate their delivery window errors. Just keep the Checkers order as is for now. I need to leave the house in an hour though.

content.text: Understood. The Checkers delivery remains confirmed. You also have a calendar reminder for your annual eye exam tomorrow. Shall I add that to your phone?

message.content: Yes, please. It’s for 2026-04-10. I’ve been ignoring it because my eyes feel fine, but Bongo kept scratching at my leg yesterday and I didn’t want to risk missing the appointment.

content.text: Added. The reminder is set for 2026-04-10. Is there anything else you need before you head out?
